critique.paragraph: The plate presents edge-of-chaos emergence as a phenomenon to witness, not entropy debt as a cost to discover. The Turing-pattern floor and particle systems demonstrate self-organization beautifully, but they celebrate complexity's arrival without asking what paid for it. Edge I requires a spatial reveal — you see the algorithm, then you see what it consumed. This map shows only the algorithm's output, making it a strong plate for emergence/criticality but an ineffective plate for entropy debt. The visual grammar reads as 'look at this beautiful complexity' rather than 'here is the price of that beauty.'
strengths: Particle systems create visible emergent behavior that changes over time
Turing-pattern floor demonstrates edge-of-chaos dynamics clearly
The λ:INDEXED label signals the parameter space being explored
Dark background makes the glowing emergence read as phenomenon
weaknesses: No spatial separation between 'algorithm' and 'cost' — everything visible simultaneously
No thermodynamic or resource consumption made visible (no heat sink, no worker, no river)
Particle beauty obscures debt rather than revealing it
No narrative arc from ignorance to knowledge of the cost
Floor pattern reads as generative art, not as something paid for by externalized disorder
next_gen_hints: Add a wall or threshold: player crosses from front (sees pattern) to back (sees cost apparatus — cooling system, energy meter, heat exhaust)
Include a heat sink artifact that glows hotter as floor patterns complexify — make thermal cost visible in real-time
Split the space: spawn side shows emergence beauty, teleporter side shows the entropy bill (decaying particles, exhausted resources)
Add decay_uniform modifier to one zone — same Turing algorithm, but visibly aging/consuming as it runs
Replace one particle system with a 'what this costs' visualization (wattage counter, thermometer rising, worker-hand animation)
Use teleporter as the teaching threshold — step through it and the floor inverts to show entropic exhaust beneath the pattern
Pair artifacts: one generates pattern (edge_core), one shows its shadow cost (entropy_meter, heat_vent) — position them as before/after revelation
